summary: Gyomu AI is a Python library that provides a unified, provider-agnostic abstraction layer over Pydantic AI for building AI applications. It manages execution runtimes, parameters, policies, tool execution, model registries, and dynamic model routing.
responsibilities: Provide a unified interface for AI generation, streaming, object generation, and embedding operations.
Integrate and manage Pydantic AI provider capabilities including model registries, agent creation, and prompt construction.
Define execution policies, parameters, and observers for monitoring and controlling AI interactions and tool loops.
Handle tool execution, configuration, and result mapping across AI interactions.
Support dynamic model routing and configuration initialization within the application.

capabilities.name: AI Provider Integration
capabilities.description: Integrates Pydantic AI models, registries, and agents with standardized error, result, and tool formats.

capabilities.name: Execution Runtime Management
capabilities.description: Manages execution contexts, runtime parameters, tool loop policies, observers, and token usage statistics for AI operations.

capabilities.name: AI Tool Execution
capabilities.description: Defines domain logic, configurations, and result structures for executing AI tools.

capabilities.name: Model Routing and Configuration
capabilities.description: Configures and executes dynamic model routing rules and routing error handling.

capabilities.name: Core Domain Models
capabilities.description: Defines core data structures for AI model representations and application-specific errors.

design_decisions: Uses Pydantic AI as the underlying provider framework while abstracting standard AI operations, results, and errors.
Separates execution concerns (such as parameters, policies, and observers) from provider-specific implementation details.
Employs explicit typing and mapping layers to bridge provider-specific outputs and exceptions with standardized application formats.
usage_guidance: Use the execution parameters and result types in `gyomu_ai.execution` to configure and invoke text generation, object generation, streaming, and embeddings.
Leverage the `gyomu_ai.provider.pydantic_ai` module for integrating Pydantic AI models, setting up model registries, and configuring routing rules.
Define and configure tools using the `gyomu_ai.tool` module to enable agent tool execution with standardized success and failure handling.
